customManagers.description: Pinned xcaddy modules in caddy/Dockerfile + backend/Dockerfile (Dependabot can't see the --with lines)

packageRules.description: Batch the routine UI updates: every non-major npm bump lands in one PR per run instead of one PR per package. Majors stay separate — they need reading.
Same for the backend's Go modules.

Hold TypeScript at 6.x: openapi-typescript (`npm run generate:api`) drives TypeScript's JS compiler API, which TS 7's native compiler doesn't ship (`ts.factory` is undefined, so the codegen crashes). CI's `tsc -b` passes on 7, so a PR wouldn't catch it — lift once openapi-typescript supports TS 7.

A Postgres major needs a data migration (pg_upgrade or dump + restore) for every existing deployment — never a routine bump. It waits on the Dependency Dashboard; tick it there for a PR once the upgrade path is handled.
One PR for the whole compiled-in edge stack: the pinned xcaddy modules …

… and the Caddy base image, in the same PR — modules pin a minimum caddy/v2 (crowdsec-bouncer 0.15.0 needs >= 2.11.7), so the two can't land apart. A human syncs backend/internal/edge/versions.json + the io.ward.* labels; the test workflow (internal/edge/versions_test.go) fails the PR until they do.
